question: Why is Śiva not the agitator of māyā merely through non-conceptual awareness?
premises: Agitation of māyā is compared to agitation of bindu
Mere non-conceptual awareness is insufficient for that role
The text states this as the intended meaning
inference: Śiva does not agitate māyā merely by non-conceptual awareness, unlike the agitation of bindu.
plain_english: The meaning is that Śiva does not agitate māyā merely through non-conceptual awareness, as in the case of the agitation of bindu.
